headline: SRIT India Limited IPO subscription and listing price overview
hook: SRIT India IPO listing details and subscription
summary: SRIT India Limited has launched its initial public offering to raise capital from the primary market. The company is listed on the NSE under the ticker SRIT. Investors are evaluating the subscription numbers and the final listing price to determine market demand. This IPO provides retail investors an opportunity to participate in the company's growth phase.
whats_next: Listing date and post-listing price performance
why_it_matters: New listing provides fresh investment opportunity in the technology sector.
